name: The Missing Customer Database
description: Synthetic cyber incident reconstruction investigating the potential unauthorized copy and exfiltration of sensitive Q3 customer records.
narrative: At approximately 10:01 AM on October 7, user 'alice' authenticated to workstation-01 following multiple failed password attempts. The user navigated to an unverified external training domain and downloaded an executable tool ('cust_db_tool.exe'). At 10:12 AM, a Kingston USB mass storage drive was connected to the host. At 10:14 AM, the primary customer database export ('customer_database_q3.csv') was accessed and copied to the removable drive. Shortly thereafter, an outbound encrypted connection transmitted 45.2MB of data to an external address (198.51.100.42:8443). A 40-minute gap in browser history was observed immediately following the incident.
